title: Functional regulation of midkine (MDK) and its link to cancer.
snippet: Midkine (MDK) is a heparin-binding growth factor that is minimally expressed in most adult tissues but markedly upregulated in a wide range of malignancies. Accumulating evidence positions MDK as a multifunctional signaling hub that orchestrates tumor progression through its pleiotropic effects on cancer cells and the tumor microenvironment. title: Molecular and immune profiling of HER2-low, HER2 ultra-low, and HER2-null male breast cancer.

title: Cytokine circuitries as determinants of response, resistance, and toxicity across cancer immunotherapy platforms.
